fullPassage: I am writing to draw your attention to a matter of great importance. Mayor Doe pledged to address the traffic problems that have plagued our community. He has failed, however, to take even the first steps toward reducing the dangerous conditions of many of the intersections surrounding our children's schools. I hope you will join me in voicing your concern over this immediate peril. Write Mayor Doe and tell him, in no uncertain terms, that it is his responsibility to protect the children by installing crosswalks and traffic lights at dangerous intersections. Let him understand that your support depends on his fulfillment of his promises to keep our streets efficient and our children safe!

questions.passage: I am writing to draw your attention to a matter of great importance. Mayor Doe (A)[refused / pledged] to address the traffic problems that have plagued our community. He has failed, however, to take even the first steps toward reducing the dangerous conditions of many of the intersections surrounding our children's schools. I hope you will join me in voicing your concern over this (B)[immediate / delayed] peril. Write Mayor Doe and tell him, in no uncertain terms, that it is his responsibility to protect the children by installing crosswalks and traffic lights at dangerous intersections. Let him understand that your support depends on his fulfillment of his promises to keep our streets (C)[efficient / dangerous] and our children safe!
questions.stem: 다음 글의 (A), (B), (C)에 들어갈 말로 가장 적절한 것끼리 짝지은 것은?

det.korean: 시장은 교통 문제를 해결하겠다고 약속했고(pledged), 필자는 이 즉각적인(immediate) 위험에 목소리를 내자고 촉구하며 거리를 안전하고 효율적으로(efficient) 유지하겠다는 약속 이행을 요구한다.
det.analysis:
✅ ① pledged — immediate — efficient: 원문 세 단어 그대로
❌ ② refused(거부했다)는 pledged(약속했다)와 정반대 행위
❌ ③ delayed(지연된)는 immediate(즉각적인)와 반대
❌ ④ dangerous(위험한)는 efficient(효율적인)와 반대 속성
det.tip: pledge(약속하다) / immediate peril(즉각적 위험) / keep streets efficient(거리를 효율적으로 유지)가 이 글의 세 핵심어.

questions.passage: I am writing to draw your attention to a matter of great importance. Mayor Doe pledged to (A)[address / ignore] the traffic problems that have plagued our community. He has failed, however, to take even the first steps toward reducing the dangerous conditions of many of the intersections surrounding our children's schools. I hope you will join me in voicing your concern over this immediate peril. Write Mayor Doe and tell him, in no uncertain terms, that it is his responsibility to (B)[harm / protect] the children by installing crosswalks and traffic lights at dangerous intersections. Let him understand that your support depends on his (C)[fulfillment / failure] of his promises to keep our streets efficient and our children safe!
questions.stem: 다음 글의 (A), (B), (C)에 들어갈 말로 가장 적절한 것끼리 짝지은 것은?

det.korean: 시장은 교통 문제를 해결(address)하겠다고 했고, 그의 책임은 아이들을 보호(protect)하는 것이며, 지지는 약속의 이행(fulfillment)에 달려 있다.
det.analysis:
✅ ① address — protect — fulfillment: 원문 세 단어 정확히 일치
❌ ② failure(실패)는 fulfillment(이행)와 반대
❌ ③ ignore(무시하다)는 address(해결하다)와 반대
❌ ④ harm(해치다)은 protect(보호하다)와 반대
det.tip: address the problem(문제를 해결하다) / protect children(아이들 보호) / fulfillment of promises(약속 이행)가 이 편지의 요구 3가지.

questions.passage: I am writing to draw your attention to a matter of great importance. Mayor Doe pledged to address the traffic problems that have (A)[improved / plagued] our community. He has failed, however, to take even the first steps toward reducing the dangerous conditions of many of the intersections surrounding our children's schools. I hope you will join me in voicing your concern over this immediate peril. Write Mayor Doe and tell him, in no uncertain terms, that it is his responsibility to protect the children by (B)[installing / removing] crosswalks and traffic lights at dangerous intersections. Let him understand that your support (C)[depends / ignores] on his fulfillment of his promises to keep our streets efficient and our children safe!
questions.stem: 다음 글의 (A), (B), (C)에 들어갈 말로 가장 적절한 것끼리 짝지은 것은?

det.korean: 교통 문제가 지역사회를 괴롭혀왔고(plagued), 해결책은 횡단보도와 신호등 설치(installing)이며, 지지는 약속 이행에 달려(depends) 있다.
det.analysis:
❌ ① ignores(무시한다)는 depends(달려있다)의 핵심 의미와 충돌
❌ ② improved(개선했다)는 plagued(괴롭혔다)와 반대
❌ ③ removing(제거하다)은 installing(설치하다)과 반대
✅ ④ plagued — installing — depends: 원문 세 단어 그대로
det.tip: plague(괴롭히다) / install crosswalks(횡단보도 설치) / support depends on(지지는 ~에 달려있다).

questions.passage: I am writing to ①<u>draw</u> your attention to a matter of great importance. Mayor Doe pledged to address the traffic problems that have ②<u>plagued</u> our community. He has failed, however, to take even the first steps toward ③<u>reducing</u> the dangerous conditions of many of the intersections surrounding our children's schools. I hope you will join me in voicing your concern over this ④<u>distant</u> peril. Write Mayor Doe and tell him, in no uncertain terms, that it is his responsibility to protect the children by installing crosswalks and traffic lights at dangerous intersections. Let him understand that your support depends on his fulfillment of his promises to keep our streets efficient and our children safe!
questions.stem: 다음 글의 밑줄 친 ①~④ 중, 문맥상 낱말의 쓰임이 적절하지 않은 것은?

det.korean: ④ distant(먼/거리가 있는)는 '지금 당장의 위험(immediate peril)'이라는 긴급한 문맥과 반대. 원문은 immediate.
det.analysis:
❌ ① draw(끌다): 'draw your attention'은 '주의를 끌다'는 관용 표현으로 적절
❌ ② plagued(괴롭혔다): 교통 문제가 지역사회를 오랫동안 괴롭혀온 맥락에 적절
❌ ③ reducing(줄이다): 위험한 상황을 줄이는 방향으로 적절
✅ ④ distant → immediate: '즉각적인 위험'을 표현해야 하는데 distant(먼)는 긴급성과 반대
det.tip: immediate peril = 즉각적인 위험. distant로 바꾸면 위험의 시급성이 사라져 글의 호소력이 무너짐.

questions.passage: I am writing to draw your attention to a matter of great importance. Mayor Doe pledged to address the traffic problems that have plagued our community. He has failed, however, to take even the first steps toward reducing the dangerous conditions of many of the intersections surrounding our children's schools. I hope you will join me in voicing your concern over this immediate peril. Write Mayor Doe and tell him, in no uncertain terms, that it is his ①<u>privilege</u> to protect the children by installing ②<u>crosswalks</u> and traffic lights at dangerous intersections. Let him understand that your support depends on his fulfillment of his promises to keep our streets ③<u>efficient</u> and our children ④<u>safe</u>!
questions.stem: 다음 글의 밑줄 친 ①~④ 중, 문맥상 낱말의 쓰임이 적절하지 않은 것은?

det.korean: ① privilege(특권)는 '아이들을 보호하는 것이 시장의 책임(responsibility)'이라는 의무 맥락과 반대. 원문은 responsibility.
det.analysis:
✅ ① privilege → responsibility: 교통 안전 확보는 시장의 선택적 특권이 아니라 의무. responsibility(책임)가 맞음
❌ ② crosswalks(횡단보도): 교차로에 설치해야 할 시설로 적절
❌ ③ efficient(효율적인): 거리를 효율적으로 유지하겠다는 약속으로 적절
❌ ④ safe(안전한): 아이들의 안전을 지키겠다는 약속으로 적절
det.tip: responsibility(책임) vs privilege(특권) — 의무냐 선택이냐의 차이. 시장의 공직 의무는 privilege가 아닌 responsibility.

questions.passage: I am writing to draw your ①<u>attention</u> to a matter of great importance. Mayor Doe pledged to address the traffic problems that have plagued our community. He has ②<u>failed</u>, however, to take even the first steps toward reducing the ③<u>harmless</u> conditions of many of the intersections surrounding our children's schools. I hope you will join me in voicing your concern over this immediate peril. Write Mayor Doe and tell him, in no uncertain terms, that it is his responsibility to protect the children by installing crosswalks and traffic lights at dangerous intersections. Let him understand that your ④<u>support</u> depends on his fulfillment of his promises to keep our streets efficient and our children safe!
questions.stem: 다음 글의 밑줄 친 ①~④ 중, 문맥상 낱말의 쓰임이 적절하지 않은 것은?

det.korean: ③ harmless(무해한)는 '위험한 교차로(dangerous intersections)'라는 문맥과 정반대. 원문은 dangerous.
det.analysis:
❌ ① attention(주의): 'draw your attention to'는 '~에 주의를 기울이도록 하다'는 적절한 표현
❌ ② failed(실패했다): 시장이 첫 걸음조차 밟지 못했다는 맥락에 적절
✅ ③ harmless → dangerous: 교차로가 위험하기 때문에 조치를 요구하는 글. harmless(무해한)면 행동 촉구 이유가 사라짐
❌ ④ support(지지): 시장의 약속 이행 여부에 지지가 달려 있다는 맥락에 적절
det.tip: dangerous intersections(위험한 교차로)가 이 편지의 핵심 근거. harmless로 바꾸면 논리 자체가 붕괴.

questions.passage: I am writing to draw your attention to a matter of great importance. Mayor Doe pledged to __________ the traffic problems that have plagued our community. He has failed, however, to take even the first steps toward reducing the dangerous conditions of many of the intersections surrounding our children's schools. I hope you will join me in voicing your concern over this immediate peril. Write Mayor Doe and tell him, in no uncertain terms, that it is his responsibility to protect the children by installing crosswalks and traffic lights at dangerous intersections. Let him understand that your support depends on his fulfillment of his promises to keep our streets efficient and our children safe!
questions.stem: 다음 글의 빈칸에 들어갈 말로 가장 적절한 것은?

det.korean: 시장 Doe는 지역사회를 괴롭혀온 교통 문제를 ____하겠다고 약속했다.
det.analysis:
❌ ① failed(실패했다): 약속의 내용이 아닌 시장의 결과를 나타내는 단어
✅ ② address(해결하다): 'pledged to address the traffic problems' — 문제를 다루고 해결하겠다는 약속의 핵심 동사
❌ ③ plagued(괴롭혔다): 교통 문제가 지역사회를 괴롭혔다는 서술이지 약속의 내용이 아님
❌ ④ protect(보호하다): 아이들을 보호하는 책임에 쓰이는 단어로 traffic problems의 목적어와 맞지 않음
det.tip: address a problem = 문제를 다루다/해결하다. pledge to address = ~을 해결하겠다고 약속하다.

questions.passage: I am writing to draw your attention to a matter of great importance. Mayor Doe pledged to address the traffic problems that have plagued our community. He has failed, however, to take even the first steps toward reducing the dangerous conditions of many of the intersections surrounding our children's schools. I hope you will join me in voicing your concern over this immediate peril. Write Mayor Doe and tell him, in no uncertain terms, that it is his responsibility to protect the children by installing crosswalks and traffic lights at dangerous intersections. Let him understand that your support depends on his fulfillment of his __________ to keep our streets efficient and our children safe!
questions.stem: 다음 글의 빈칸에 들어갈 말로 가장 적절한 것은?

det.korean: 당신의 지지는 거리를 안전하고 효율적으로 유지하겠다는 그의 ______ 이행에 달려 있다.
det.analysis:
❌ ① concern(우려): 걱정의 표현이지 이행의 대상이 아님
❌ ② peril(위험): 위험 상황이지 시장이 이행해야 할 대상이 아님
❌ ③ fulfillment(이행): fulfillment of fulfillment는 중복. 이행의 대상이 필요함
✅ ④ promises(약속): 'fulfillment of his promises' — 시장이 공약한 내용의 이행을 요구. fulfillment와 쌍을 이루는 핵심어
det.tip: fulfillment of promises = 약속 이행. 이 글 전체 요지가 '공약 이행'이므로 promises가 핵심.

questions.passage: I am writing to draw your attention to a matter of great importance. Mayor Doe pledged to address the traffic problems that have plagued our community. He has failed, however, to take even the first steps toward reducing the dangerous conditions of many of the intersections surrounding our children's schools. I hope you will join me in voicing your concern over this immediate __________. Write Mayor Doe and tell him, in no uncertain terms, that it is his responsibility to protect the children by installing crosswalks and traffic lights at dangerous intersections. Let him understand that your support depends on his fulfillment of his promises to keep our streets efficient and our children safe!
questions.stem: 다음 글의 빈칸에 들어갈 말로 가장 적절한 것은?

det.korean: 이 즉각적인 ____에 대한 우려의 목소리를 함께 내주길 바란다.
det.analysis:
✅ ① peril(위험): 'immediate peril' — 교통 사고 위험에 대한 즉각적 우려를 표현하는 핵심어
❌ ② support(지지): 빈칸 뒤 'over this immediate ____'의 맥락에서 concern의 대상은 위험이어야 함
❌ ③ community(지역사회): concern over a community는 위험 상황 표현이 아님
❌ ④ attention(주의): concern over attention은 의미 구성이 어색함
det.tip: immediate peril = 즉각적인 위험. peril은 danger보다 격식체·문어체 표현으로 공개서한에 적합.

questions.passage: I am writing to draw your attention to a matter of great importance. Mayor Doe <u>pledged</u> to address the traffic problems that have plagued our community. He has failed, however, to take even the first steps toward reducing the dangerous conditions of many of the intersections surrounding our children's schools. I hope you will join me in voicing your concern over this immediate peril. Write Mayor Doe and tell him, in no uncertain terms, that it is his responsibility to protect the children by installing crosswalks and traffic lights at dangerous intersections. Let him understand that your support depends on his fulfillment of his promises to keep our streets efficient and our children safe!
questions.stem: 다음 글의 밑줄 친 pledged의 의미와 가장 가까운 것은?

det.korean: 시장 Doe는 교통 문제를 해결하겠다고 약속했다(pledged).
det.analysis:
❌ ① denied(부정했다): pledged(약속했다)와 반대 방향
❌ ② forgot(잊었다): 약속 행위와 무관
✅ ③ promised(약속했다): pledged의 직접 동의어. '공식적으로 약속하다'의 의미
❌ ④ refused(거부했다): 약속과 반대되는 행위
det.tip: pledge ≈ promise (공식적·약속의 의미). pledge는 특히 공적 약속/서약에 쓰이는 격식체.

questions.passage: I am writing to draw your attention to a matter of great importance. Mayor Doe pledged to address the traffic problems that have plagued our community. He has failed, however, to take even the first steps toward reducing the dangerous conditions of many of the intersections surrounding our children's schools. I hope you will join me in voicing your concern over this immediate <u>peril</u>. Write Mayor Doe and tell him, in no uncertain terms, that it is his responsibility to protect the children by installing crosswalks and traffic lights at dangerous intersections. Let him understand that your support depends on his fulfillment of his promises to keep our streets efficient and our children safe!
questions.stem: 다음 글의 밑줄 친 peril의 의미와 가장 가까운 것은?

det.korean: 이 즉각적인 위험(peril)에 대한 우려의 목소리를 내주시길 바란다.
det.analysis:
❌ ① opportunity(기회): 위험과 반대되는 긍정적 상황
✅ ② danger(위험): peril의 직접 동의어. '심각한 위험'을 뜻함
❌ ③ benefit(이익): 위험 상황과 반대 의미
❌ ④ comfort(편안함): 위험과 반대 상태
det.tip: peril ≈ danger (위험). peril은 더 심각하고 격식체인 표현.

questions.passage: I am writing to draw your attention to a matter of great importance. Mayor Doe pledged to address the traffic problems that have plagued our community. He has failed, however, to take even the first steps toward reducing the dangerous conditions of many of the intersections surrounding our children's schools. I hope you will join me in voicing your concern over this immediate peril. Write Mayor Doe and tell him, in no uncertain terms, that it is his responsibility to protect the children by installing crosswalks and traffic lights at dangerous intersections. Let him understand that your support depends on his <u>fulfillment</u> of his promises to keep our streets efficient and our children safe!
questions.stem: 다음 글의 밑줄 친 fulfillment의 의미와 가장 가까운 것은?

det.korean: 당신의 지지는 거리를 효율적이고 안전하게 유지하겠다는 약속의 이행(fulfillment)에 달려 있다.
det.analysis:
❌ ① violation(위반): fulfillment(이행)의 반의어 계열
❌ ② neglect(방치): 이행과 반대되는 방기 행위
✅ ③ achievement(달성/성취): fulfillment의 가장 가까운 동의어. 목표·약속을 이루는 것
❌ ④ realization(인식/깨달음): 동의어 계열이나 '약속 이행'보다는 '깨닫는 것'의 뉘앙스
det.tip: fulfillment ≈ achievement(달성). 약속을 '이행하다 = 달성하다/성취하다'.

questions.passage: I am writing to draw your attention to a matter of great importance. Mayor Doe pledged to address the traffic problems that have plagued our community. He has failed, however, to take even the first steps toward reducing the dangerous conditions of many of the intersections surrounding our children's schools. I hope you will join me in voicing your concern over this immediate peril. Write Mayor Doe and tell him, in no uncertain terms, that it is his responsibility to protect the children by installing crosswalks and traffic lights at dangerous intersections. Let him understand that your support depends on his fulfillment of his promises to keep our streets <u>efficient</u> and our children safe!
questions.stem: 다음 글의 밑줄 친 efficient의 의미와 가장 반대인 것은?

det.korean: 거리를 효율적으로(efficient) 유지하겠다는 약속.
det.analysis:
✅ ① wasteful(낭비적인): efficient(효율적인)의 직접 반의어. 자원·시간을 낭비하는 상태
❌ ② productive(생산적인): efficient의 동의어 계열
❌ ③ effective(효과적인): efficient의 동의어 계열
❌ ④ organized(체계적인): efficient와 유사한 긍정적 속성
det.tip: efficient(효율적) ↔ wasteful(낭비적). 최소 자원으로 최대 효과 vs. 자원을 낭비.

questions.passage: I am writing to draw your attention to a matter of great importance. Mayor Doe pledged to address the traffic problems that have <u>plagued</u> our community. He has failed, however, to take even the first steps toward reducing the dangerous conditions of many of the intersections surrounding our children's schools. I hope you will join me in voicing your concern over this immediate peril. Write Mayor Doe and tell him, in no uncertain terms, that it is his responsibility to protect the children by installing crosswalks and traffic lights at dangerous intersections. Let him understand that your support depends on his fulfillment of his promises to keep our streets efficient and our children safe!
questions.stem: 다음 글의 밑줄 친 plagued의 의미와 가장 반대인 것은?

det.korean: 지역사회를 괴롭혀온(plagued) 교통 문제.
det.analysis:
❌ ① troubled(괴롭힌): plagued의 동의어
❌ ② harassed(성가시게 한): plagued의 동의어 계열
✅ ③ improved(개선한): plagued(괴롭혔다)의 반의어. 부정적 영향 vs 긍정적 개선
❌ ④ affected(영향을 미친): 중립적 의미로 반의어가 아님
det.tip: plague(괴롭히다) ↔ improve(개선하다). 지역사회에 해를 끼침 vs. 지역사회를 좋게 만듦.

questions.passage:
(A) She wrote the <u>address</u> on the envelope and walked to the post office to mail the letter.

(B) Mayor Doe pledged to <u>address</u> the traffic problems that have plagued our community.
questions.stem: (A)와 (B)의 밑줄 친 address의 문맥적 의미로 가장 적절한 것은?

det.korean: (A) wrote on the envelope — 우편 발송을 위해 적는 주소. (B) pledged to address problems — 문제를 다루고 해결하겠다는 동사적 의미.
det.analysis:
❌ ① 둘 다 '주소'로 보면 (B)의 'pledged to address'가 동사로 쓰인 맥락과 불일치
✅ ② (A) 주소 — (B) 다루다/해결하다: (A)는 명사(우편 주소), (B)는 동사(문제를 다루다)
❌ ③ 정반대 해석
❌ ④ (A)의 'fill with water' 맥락과 '다루다' 해석은 모순
det.tip: address의 이중 용법: (명사) 주소 / (동사) 문제·상황을 다루다. 동사 address는 deal with/tackle의 격식체.

questions.stem: 다음 영영 정의에 해당하는 단어로 가장 적절한 것은? "a situation of serious and immediate danger"

det.korean: 심각하고 즉각적인 위험 상황.
det.analysis:
❌ ① concern(우려): 걱정이지 위험 상황 자체가 아님
❌ ② community(지역사회): 사람 집단으로 위험 상황과 무관
❌ ③ fulfillment(이행/성취): 약속을 실현하는 행위이지 위험이 아님
✅ ④ peril(위험): 'serious and immediate danger'의 격식체 표현으로 직접 대응
det.tip: peril = serious/immediate danger. 공식 문서·편지에서 강한 위험을 표현할 때 사용.

questions.passage: It is his responsibility to protect the children by __________ (install) crosswalks and traffic lights at dangerous intersections.
questions.stem: 다음 글의 빈칸에 괄호 안의 단어를 알맞은 형태로 바꿔 쓰시오. (영어로, 1단어)

det.korean: 위험한 교차로에 횡단보도와 신호등을 설치함으로써 아이들을 보호하는 것이 그의 책임이다.
det.analysis: 전치사 by 다음에는 동명사(-ing)가 와야 함. install의 동명사형은 installing. 'by + V-ing' 구조.
det.tip: by + 동명사(-ing) = ~함으로써. install → installing (자음 중복 없음, 그대로 -ing 추가).

questions.passage: Mayor Doe __________ (pledge) to address the traffic problems that have plagued our community.
questions.stem: 다음 글의 빈칸에 괄호 안의 단어를 알맞은 형태로 바꿔 쓰시오. (영어로, 1단어)

det.korean: 시장 Doe는 지역사회를 괴롭혀온 교통 문제를 해결하겠다고 약속했다.
det.analysis: 주어가 Mayor Doe(3인칭 단수), 시제는 과거(서한 문맥). pledge의 과거형은 pledged. 과거 시제 + 규칙 변화.
det.tip: pledge → pledged (규칙 변화 과거형). 문맥상 과거 시제.

questions.passage: I am writing to draw your attention to a matter of great importance. Mayor Doe pledged to address the traffic problems that have plagued our community. He has failed, however, to take even the first steps toward reducing the dangerous conditions of many of the intersections surrounding our children's schools. I hope you will join me in voicing your concern over this immediate peril. Write Mayor Doe and tell him, in no uncertain terms, that __________ by installing crosswalks and traffic lights at dangerous intersections. Let him understand that your support depends on his fulfillment of his promises to keep our streets efficient and our children safe!
questions.stem: 다음 글의 빈칸에 들어갈 말로 가장 적절한 것은?

det.korean: 시장에게 단호히 편지를 써서 '____'라고 말하라.
det.analysis:
❌ ① 'he failed to take even the first steps': 시장의 실패를 서술하는 문장이지 편지로 전달할 핵심 메시지가 아님
❌ ② 'he pledged to reduce dangerous conditions': 원문에 없는 표현. pledge의 내용이 아님
✅ ③ 'it is his responsibility to protect the children': tell him that ____ 구조에서 시장에게 직접 전달할 핵심 의무. 아이들 보호가 그의 책임임을 통보
❌ ④ 'your support depends on his fulfillment': 결말 경고 문장이지 tell him 뒤 핵심 요구와 다름
det.tip: tell him that + 핵심 메시지. 편지의 요구 핵심은 '아이들을 보호하는 것이 그의 책임'임을 통보.

det.korean: 당신의 지지는 그의 약속 이행에 달려 있다 — 그 약속의 내용은 '____'.
det.analysis:

❌ ② 'voice your concern over this immediate peril': 독자에게 촉구하는 행동이지 시장의 약속 내용이 아님

det.tip: promises to + 동사구. keep streets efficient and children safe — 이 두 목표가 시장 공약의 핵심.
